headline: Argentine Peso Hits Record Low as Parallel FX Gap Widens and Reserves Stagnate
summary: The Argentine peso fell to record lows across exchange bands as accelerating devaluation pressures and stagnant central bank foreign reserves widened the parallel market gap. November surveys showed moderate price movements.
why: Argentina's foreign exchange dynamics and central bank reserve levels are critical indicators of macroeconomic stability and debt service capacity.

impacts.name: Argentine Peso
impacts.why: The peso reached record lows amid foreign exchange reserve pressures.
